name: peek-controls-native-look
description: Peek controls, both looks: with opaqueSurround on, the /peekctl document picks up the atrium-native-chrome class the same way /commandbar does (command-bar-native-look.json is this scenario's model). overlay.css's .ov-btn rule (border-radius: 9px) is not one of the tokens html.atrium-native-chrome redefines, so the buttons keep the same 9px corner in both looks - this scenario checks that the class landed AND that the radius did not silently change under it, rather than assuming a native variant means a different radius. Same fixture, gate and link coordinates as peek-controls-close-the-card.json, plus the settings fixture command-bar-native-look.json already uses for opaqueSurround.
